title: Chapter 297: Changes In The Desert Battlefield
content:
Chapter 297: Changes In The Desert Battlefield

Just as the Zerg race was fighting the alien race and the demon race, a new situation appeared in the desert battlefield opened up by the Naga race.

The desert race, which had been quiet for a long time, finally received a large-scale reinforcement.

This was the first formal attack launched by the desert race after the Naga race's strong men fought against the desert race's strong men. It was extraordinary.

Through the Zerg host, it can be seen that outside the Naga desert main city, the wind and sand that never stop blowing day and night are densely packed with troops of various desert races.

Among them, the magic arms of various races took advantage of the wind and sand to launch various wind and sand magics at the Naga desert main city.

This made the wind and sand, which were originally normal, begin to carry wind blades, sand arrows and various simulated sand magic attacks, which had a lot of impact on the Naga desert main city garrisoning the city wall and the troops stationed in the city.

These magic attacks were just appetizers before the war, and the real feast was the countless desert race armies that followed.

For the desert race attacking from the ground, there are more than 500,000 Zerg destroyers to suppress the firepower. The Naga tribe can still deal with it temporarily, but the countless desert eagles flying in mixed with the wind and sand have to rely on the Naga tribe's anti-aircraft firepower.

Once this battle started, the Naga tribe's millions of troops all took action. The attack launched by the desert race from the air has seriously affected the safety of the desert main city and the Zerg destroyers.

The desert eagle is a kind of fierce bird living in the desert area. It has adapted to the desert environment and can fly in the wind and sand to hunt. It is very powerful.

Now the desert eagle took advantage of the wind and sand to fly directly into the Naga desert main city. The Naga army was fully dispatched to take the responsibility of air defense.

When the host No. 3 discovered the desert eagle, he had already reminded Naga, but the Naga tribe had no good way to deal with the desert eagle that invaded from high altitude with the help of the wind and sand.

A large number of Naga mages began to clear the wind and sand in the desert main city, and quickly covered the desert main city under the protection of the giant luck formation.

This kind of luck formation that covers the whole city can defend against most large-scale battlefield magic that changes the environment. It is specially prepared by the Naga tribe for opening up the desert battlefield, but this luck formation cannot defend against the enemy's attack.

With the protection of the luck formation, the area of the Naga desert main city has stopped wind and sand, and the vision is clear, and a large number of desert eagles flying in the air are exposed.

The various siege weapons that can be deployed in the city by the Naga tribe, the various anti-aircraft weapons of the Naga army, and the various magics of the Naga mages are all attacked at the same time.

The overwhelming desert eagles launched a wind magic attack on the desert main city below, and fierce air strikes and air defense operations broke out between the two sides.

The desert eagle fell, the wind blades raged, and both sides paid a lot of casualties.

The position of more than 500,000 Zerg destroyers, which is a very obvious target, is the key protection area of the Naga tribe. A large number of Naga air defense forces gathered in the surrounding area to stop the attack of the desert eagle.

But it still couldn't stop a large number of Desert Eagles from flying in from high altitude and attacking the Zerg Destroyer positions that occupied a large area.

From time to time, sharp wind blades flew into the Zerg Destroyer positions, cutting scars on the Zerg Destroyer's shells, but such damage was not enough to cause much impact on the Zerg Destroyer.

Unless the Zerg Destroyer was extremely unlucky and the jet channel was damaged, it would not affect their attack.

Seeing that the Zerg Destroyer was attacked and damaged, Naga was a little anxious.

More than 500,000 Zerg Destroyers have now become the key to the Naga tribe's defense of the desert main city, and no major losses are allowed.

In this situation, Wu Qing's consciousness possessed host No. 3.

"Elder, don't worry, as long as the Zerg Destroyer doesn't die, the injury will recover soon!"

"If they are upgraded, their injuries and status will also be restored!"

Wu Qing explained to Naga through host No. 3.

"Send all the luck beads over!"

Naga ordered her men.

She raised her head and said to Host No. 3: "No. 3, the luck beads are all given to you, you upgrade according to the actual situation!"

"Don't save, try to ensure that the ground firepower is not interrupted!"

If the firepower output of the Zerg destroyer is affected, the ground defense of the Naga army will also have problems.

The Naga tribe can detect the difference in the desert race's attack this time without the Zerg host providing intelligence, and the real main force of the desert race has arrived.

"Okay! We will ensure the continuity of ground firepower! As long as the strength is upgraded, the firepower output will be strengthened to a certain extent!"

Wu Qing responded through Host No. 3.

"I have another suggestion. My tribe controls millions of poisonous ray scorpions underground outside the city. We can release them into the city to assist in air defense and defense!"

"The nobles should have received intelligence that my tribe has already used a large number of poisonous ray scorpions in public battlefields!"

"The desert race's attack this time is very large-scale. These millions of poisonous ray scorpions are a great force!"

"It would be a waste if they were consumed directly in the battle outside the city!"

Wu Qing originally planned to let the poisonous ray scorpions controlled by the Zerg host take action at critical moments and use them as consumables. The battlefield situation he saw now gave him a new idea. These poisonous ray scorpions may be able to play a greater role.

Nagaya was indeed paying attention to the performance of the Zerg on the public battlefield through the intelligence within the clan. She was very surprised that the Zerg could produce a large number of the Zerg's poisonous ray scorpions just after they obtained some of the body tissues of the poisonous ray scorpion. .

Because the Nagas have had direct contact with the poisonous ray scorpions, they can see the differences in some of the Zerg's poisonous ray scorpions. Naga knows that the Zerg's poisonous ray scorpions have been strengthened.

These are the secrets of the Zerg tribe, and Nagaya never mentioned them to Host No. 3.

Now Wu Qing took the initiative to raise this issue through Host No. 3, which made Nagaya a little itchy and couldn't help but ask the question in her mind.

"No. 3, how did you create a Zerg poisonous ray scorpion that is stronger than the poisonous ray scorpion in such a short period of time?"

Wu Qing did not hide anything, and said through Host No. 3: "This is the wonder of the gene evolution route of the Zerg body!"

"Of course, nothing in the world is perfect. There are wonderful places and shortcomings!"

"If the elder is interested, you can learn this knowledge in the future!"

After hearing this, Nagaya said seriously: "This kind of magic is really awe-inspiring!"

"Since you are confident of controlling the poisonous ray scorpions outside the city, I will personally coordinate this matter!"

Nagaya didn't say any more, but turned around and left quickly. She wanted to personally report Wu Qing's suggestions to the senior leaders of the clan.

The Naga tribe has enough troops to continue to invest in the desert battlefield, but as a large tribe, the Naga tribe also has many problems to face. Investing too much force in the desert battlefield will have some impact on other places.

The Nagas have somewhat underestimated the risks of opening up a desert battlefield. This ancient desert territory has undergone great changes under the development of the evil god camp.

The Naga tribe had already noticed this from their confrontation with the powerful desert race men who came quickly.

The current intensity of the desert race's attack is somewhat beyond the Naga clan's expectations, which further confirms the Naga clan's suspicion.

"There must be a powerful evil god who conquered this desert, so that the desert races can be unified and commanded to organize such a large-scale attack in such a short period of time!"

"Faced with such an enemy, it would be a bit overwhelming for our clan to open this battlefield on our own!"

"Now we have two options. One is to choose a person with spare power from the big clans we have good relations with, and cooperate with them to open up the desert battlefield!"

"The second is to cooperate with the Zerg to open up the desert battlefield. The Zerg has shown strength that exceeds that of the general big clan. Although they have not yet obtained the status of a big clan, their combat strength is no worse than that of the general big clan, or even stronger!"

"The situation is urgent, please express your opinion!"

The situation in the main desert city of the Naga tribe was reported to the top management. The top management of the Naga tribe was always paying attention to the progress of opening up the desert battlefield and immediately held an emergency meeting.

"The big families that have some relationship with us either have no spare power, or they are smiling tigers who will take advantage of the opportunity. I do not advocate cooperation with them unless it is a last resort!"

"It is only a matter of time before the Zerg will gain the status of a major clan. Our clan has always cooperated happily with the Zerg. Our clan can also be of some help in the matter of the Zerg gaining the status of a major clan. It is a good choice to continue to deepen cooperation with the Zerg! "

"The performance of the Zerg on the public battlefield has amazed many big clans. If they gain the status of a big clan, they will definitely become the strongest race under the super clan, and they will eventually become a super clan. There is great hope!"

"At this time, our tribe will give up some benefits and make good friends with the Zerg tribe, and we will not suffer any loss!"

"..."

The senior leaders of the Naga clan are very pragmatic and basically advocate deepening cooperation with the Zerg and allowing the Zerg to officially participate in the opening up of the desert battlefield.

Everyone is optimistic about the development potential of the Zerg and is willing to deepen the cooperative relationship with the Zerg at this time.

Opening up a new battlefield and meeting certain conditions can yield huge benefits, which can greatly promote the development of the race.

The Naga tribe hired Zerg troops to participate in the war, and finally successfully opened up the battlefield, and only the Naga tribe would benefit.

These are the rules of the world. They are absolutely fair and selfless and cannot be cheated.

If the Naga tribe does not pay the price to hire the Zerg army, but allows the Zerg tribe to freely participate in the opening of the desert battlefield, and eventually the desert battlefield is successfully opened, the Naga tribe and the Zerg tribe will have to distribute the benefits according to their contribution.

This desert battlefield is the space coordinates found by the Naga tribe. It is the space transmission channel opened by the Naga tribe. The Naga tribe has the right to decide who will participate.

Therefore, the Naga tribe's decision to allow the Zerg tribe to participate in the opening of the desert battlefield is a huge strategically significant concession.
